facts.text: I teach middle school students the basics of healthy and safe cooking.
I want to support learners to recall and process accurate foundational information without using quizzes.
I believe quizzes only enable short-term recall rather than long-term memorisation.
I want to use two instructional strategies proven to increase effective memorisation of foundational knowledge.
The first strategy I will use is known as Undoing.
I believe learning experiences should intentionally challenge commonly mistaken foundational ideas and assumptions.
I believe the highest impact learning experiences identify and correct foundational misconceptions before memorisation occurs.
I believe Undoing activities are helpful at the start of the learning process by identifying and correcting gaps in knowledge, misconceptions, and misplaced reasoning.
I believe Undoing activities often ask learners to predict the outcome of a scenario.
I want to generate an undoing activity related to core foundational knowledge for cooking healthy meals.
I want feedback for each potential response that explains the difference between the student's response and the correct answer.
I want the feedback to replace misconceptions with alternative correct conceptions and explain how they differ.
I want to suggest a resource for the defined learner type to learn the correct version of the foundational knowledge.
I asked for one more activity similar to the previous one.
I asked for a link or proper citation information for the resource.

events.text: Requested generation of an undoing activity for core foundational knowledge about cooking healthy meals.
Requested one more similar activity and asked for a link or proper citation for the resource.
